newsitem.title: SPAIN: Endesa shares outperform on Chile deal news.
newsitem.headline: Endesa shares outperform on Chile deal news.

text.p: Shares in Spain's Endesa were still outperforming the market on Friday, although off earlier highs, after the announcement of a $1.5 billion deal with Chile's Enersis.
"It's good news from a strategic point of view but any results will begin to be seen in the medium term," said an analyst.
"Endesa is playing high stakes and it will now be necessary to check the Chilean group's figures carefully. It confirms Endesa's intention of playing the Latin American market", said a dealer.
Overall, this deal was not seen to affect the placement of 35 pct of Endesa capital next October.
At 1315 GMT, Endesa was 60 pesetas up at 3.260, while the Ibex 35 was 31,98 down at 6.778,91.
